name: Reclaim.ai
summary: Auto-schedules tasks, habits and meetings around your stated priorities. Google Calendar-first, so Outlook-heavy teams are out, and the free tier is limited.
best_for: Google Calendar teams that want AI to auto-schedule tasks, habits and meetings around their priorities
skip_if: you run hosted or on-premise Exchange, which Reclaim's help centre lists as unsupported, or you don't overbook your calendar: the auto-scheduling has little to optimize
honest_knock: The magic only works on a calendar it can write to. Google Calendar was first, but Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and Exchange-backed accounts are supported too (reclaim.ai/integrations/outlook-calendar, read 15 September 2026); Reclaim's own help centre still lists hosted and on-premise Exchange as unsupported. The free tier is quite limited. A genuine time-saver for the right setup, useless for the wrong one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month billed yearly ($12 monthly)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on reclaim.ai/pricing, USD, and in our own test that day; earlier: re-verified 2026-10-03) Four levels, and the page keeps both billing terms in the markup rather than recomputing them. Lite is free forever for a single user. Billed yearly the seats are Starter $10, Business $15 and Enterprise $22 per seat a month; billed monthly Starter is $12 and Business $18, and the monthly column marks Enterprise 'Unavailable on monthly plans'. Seats are capped by tier rather than open: 1 user on Lite, up to 10 on Starter, up to 100 on Business and over 100 on Enterprise, with the AI-agent allowance per seat stepping 5, 10, 100 and unlimited beside them. Calendar Syncs are counted per plan: 1 on Lite, 3 on Starter and unlimited from Business. In our test on 18 November 2026 the app showed Unlimited Calendar Syncs on Starter, and on Lite the 'Add a sync' button carried a STARTER label, so check the count in your own account. The Attendee Unit packs are no longer shown: on 18 November 2026 the page showed neither the AU packs nor the '20% off with code MEETINGS' banner. Both are still in the page code but hidden, so we no longer count either as part of the price. Our October reading listed AU packs from $8 for 3 on Starter, for attendees without a paid seat in Smart Meetings of 3 or more. The page now lists four discounts you apply for: Student 50% for 12 months (students, educators and faculty), Nonprofit 20% for 3 years, Startup 20% for 3 years, and Switching Providers 20% for 6 months when you move from Clockwise, Motion or Calendly. The site now carries a Dropbox Reclaim logo (alt text 'Reclaim.ai from Dropbox').
